question: Mouma Das, who received Padma Shri Award in 2021, is a player of which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Table Tennis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mouma Das** is an Indian** table tennis player** who received India's **fourth highest civilian award** the **Padma Shri Award in 2021.**
 
• She has won multiple medals at the **Commonwealth Games** including a **gold** in the Women's Team Competition in 2018.
 
• She was awarded the **Arjuna Award**, India's **second-highest sporting honour** in 2013.
 
• **Mouma Das** and **Manika Batra **became the** first Indian pair **(and the first Indians in over 61 years) to** reach the quarterfinals of the women's doubles event at the 2017 World Table Tennis Championship.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​The Padma Awards are announced annually on **Republic Day (26th January)**.
 
• **Balbir Singh Sr** became the** first recipient of the Padma Shri award** in Sports category in** 1957**. He was a Hockey player who scored **six goals** including a hat-trick in the final against** Britain at London Olympics in 1948**.
 
• **Padma Shree Award** is conferred in recognition of **"distinguished contribution in various spheres of activity including the arts, education, industry, literature, science, acting, medicine, social service and public affairs".**
